product_overview: A desktop application for managing certificates with user authentication, role-based access, detailed reporting, and customizable settings, built with C#, WPF, and .NET 8.
core_goals: Enable secure user authentication with role-based access control.
Manage the full lifecycle of certificates including creation, editing, deletion, searching, and validation.
Provide interactive reporting dashboards with visual charts and export capabilities.
Offer application settings for customization including theming, font scaling, and database backup.
key_features: User login and user management with role-based permissions.
Certificate lifecycle management: create, edit, delete, search, and validate certificates.
Interactive dashboard containing 6 charts to visualize report data.
PDF and Excel export functionality for reports.
Settings management for themes, font scaling, and database backups.
SQLite database integration for storage and data management.
user_flow_summary: User opens application and logs in with username and password.
Based on user role, access control determines available features.
User navigates to certificate management to create, edit, search, or validate certificates.
User accesses reporting dashboard to view interactive charts and export reports to PDF or Excel.
User customizes application settings including theme and font scale, and manages database backup.
User logs out and exits the application.
validation_criteria: User authentication enforces security and role-based access appropriately.
Certificate operations correctly create, edit, delete, search, and validate with data persisted in the SQLite database.
Dashboard displays 6 interactive charts with accurate data representation.
Reports can be exported successfully to PDF and Excel formats with correct content.
Settings changes such as theme and font scaling persist and apply correctly.
Database backup functionality works as intended without data loss.
